name: Foam
author: E. T. Carter
description: Rafts of glowing sea-foam bubble rings drift on black water, each ring carrying a single specular highlight; bubbles swell, ride, then pop and collapse inward with a flash and a scatter of sparkles while the rafts shear apart and regather on a slow current loop.

params.label: Bubble size
params.effect: Characteristic radius of the bubble rings; small makes fine dense froth, large makes sparse open clusters of big soap rings.

params.label: Pop rate
params.effect: Turnover speed of bubble lifecycles; low lets bubbles ride long between rare pops, high keeps the rafts fizzing.

params.label: Drift speed
params.effect: Rate of the rafts' current-loop drift and shear; at 0 the rafts hold station while bubbles still swell and pop in place.
